title: Hanford's six pump-and-treat facilities surpass 38 billion gallons treated
summary: Washington Ecology reports that six Hanford groundwater pump-and-treat facilities have treated more than 38 billion gallons; the largest system can treat up to 2,500 gallons per minute. Denominator: Cumulative gallons treated across six Hanford pump-and-treat facilities since operations began in the 1990s; capacity for the largest 200 West system is a separate denominator.
